Unclosed execution recovery initially lost Retry request: red test proved pending None, fixed via matching recovery intent replay.

Completion/promotion exceptions initially could report a handled Tool error or roll files back after durable success; red tests drove explicit fatal completion behavior and reconciliable final promotion.

Unhashable malformed manifest state caused TypeError; string/type guards now reject visibly, with sibling outcome/progress guards.

Unresolved recovery blocked task dispatch but initially allowed manual Compression; red test drove same safety check at that Provider-dispatch seam.

Matching only current opening left undone Tool results in a later read-only Retry inherited from the target execution. Replay now tracks contributor opening tuples solely across inherited pending prefixes; durable recovery intent invalidates a contributing target, while independent same-ordinal and later-task pending work stays intact.

Snapshot storage exclusion existed only at mutation apply. With HOME inside Workspace Root, ordinary read_file exposed a private before-image in actual Provider input. Central workspace exclusions now cover all recovery-* project companions for reads/search/list and Project Instructions reuse the same boundary; direct/alias/cross-project tests pass.
limitations: No paid calls, installs, sudo or push; no external documentation lookup was needed for this stdlib/filesystem business logic.
Interrupted restoration with mixed exact states stays visibly unresolved; Resume never automatically restores files.
Concurrent/actively racing external writers and filesystem corruption are outside the approved contract.
Newly created workspace regular files use explicit0600 mode so the intended after-state is exact; existing file modes are preserved.

proposed_context_edits.File checkpoint: One owner-only exact before/after restore set for the latest Session/Run/opening execution changed by write/edit/apply_patch, including failed/interrupted work; coalesces canonical paths to first before/final after, retains bytes/absence/modes/link identity, and excludes shell and earlier Retry executions. /recover previews, requires literal yes outside plan, refuses whole-set conflicts and consumes availability after durable success.
proposed_context_edits.Undo: Append: Conversation-only; it does not restore workspace files or remove the latest File checkpoint.
proposed_context_edits.Retry: Append: Each explicit Retry has a separate execution/restore set with the original ordinal. A matching durable file-recovery intent discards obsolete assistant/Tool prefix, fetched URLs, Todo effects and Gemini replay; Retry then starts fresh from the saved request with current route/config/mode. Unrelated pending work and successful-task Undo semantics remain unchanged. Matching includes target execution prefixes inherited by explicit Retry; it does not use ordinal equality alone.
proposed_context_edits.Call Log: Append: Compact file_recovery_started/file_recovery_finished records attribute exact execution and outcome, durably invalidating only matching pending continuation. Exact file images live solely in the owner-only recovery companion; Conversation remains solely in Call Log.
proposed_context_edits.Mutating Tools decision: Replace the obsolete no-before-image/Git-only revert sentence with: Approved write/edit/apply_patch operations durably capture bounded intent before mutation and observed after-state before dependent dispatch, preserving partial-write/patch rollback. Latest-only recovery-<Session Id>/ companions are0700/0600, with min(current PA_MAX_WRITE_BYTES,4MiB)/image,64 canonical paths,16MiB combined images,24MiB/manifest and80MiB latest/active/temp per Session. Unsafe links/owner/permissions, excluded paths, integrity conflicts and would-exceed operations refuse rather than silently lose recovery. Workspace reads/search/list and Project Instructions @refs also exclude recovery storage, including resolved aliases and other project companions within Workspace Root.
